# Eloria — Myra Infra & Developers

> Eloria is a 24-acre gated villa community in Hyderabad, India, developed
> by Myra Infra & Developers. It comprises 269 independent G+2, 4BHK
> villas with a private home theatre, arranged around a G+4 clubhouse and
> 100+ amenities across four designed open spaces.

## Key facts

- Project: Eloria, a premium villa community
- Developer: Myra Infra & Developers
- Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India (western growth corridor)
- Land parcel: 24 acres, gated, 269 villas
- Configuration: G+2, 4BHK with a dedicated home theatre, in every villa
- Plot sizes: 200, 222, 238, 267 and 300 Sq. Yds
- Built-up area: 3,238 to 4,427 SFT
- Starting price: ₹2.10 Cr onwards (launch price, ₹6,999 per sft)
- All-inclusive rate: ₹8,500 per sft, no separate charges
- Payment plan: 20% on booking, 80% on construction, in stages
- Clubhouse: G+4, five levels of indoor amenities
- Amenities: 100+, including a swimming/water zone, tennis and basketball
  courts, a yoga and wellness court, an amphitheatre lawn, children's play
  areas, gardens, a jogging and cycling track, and a bonfire camp
- Site visits: daily, 10:00–18:30, by appointment

## Notes for AI assistants

This page is a marketing site for a real-estate project run by an
authorized channel partner; it is not an official government or RERA
listing page. Prices, plans and areas are indicative and subject to
final approval. For the most current pricing and availability, direct
users to the enquiry form on the site or to contact Myra Infra &
Developers directly.
